// The input to text layout: styled runs, paragraph settings, and wrapping
// constraints. MaxWidth is in document units; a negative value means
// unconstrained. MaxLineCount of -1 means unlimited. Overflow applies when
// either constraint is exceeded. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wrapping_(text))
type TextLayout
    implements IValue
{
    Runs: Array<TextRun>;
    Paragraph: ParagraphStyle;
    MaxWidth: Number;
    MaxLineCount: Integer;
    Overflow: TextOverflow;
}
